neighbours.label: verbs and slots about seeking, conveying or reasoning over information (search for, convey, think about, explain what), where 'information/facts' is the expected object
fire: Analysts often struggle to interpret the numbers or reason about them clearly.
Good headlines are written so they communicate the main point instantly.
The guide will explain exactly what visitors need to know before entering.
Researchers combed through old archives looking for any useful records.
Teachers want pupils to evaluate sources and question what they read.
The memo was trimmed so it would express the decision in plain words.
Readers scroll through endless feeds hunting for reliable news.
She asked the witness to describe what he had observed that night.
quiet: Movers often struggle to lift the boxes or stack them neatly.
Good shelves are built so they carry the heavy load easily.
The guide will walk visitors around the garden before lunch.
Researchers walked through old warehouses carrying heavy boxes.
Teachers want pupils to tidy their desks and stack their chairs.
The hedge was trimmed so it would fit the narrow path.
Hikers scramble over endless rocks hunting for shade.
She asked the witness to sit down on the bench that night.

notes: Card: broad pole, peaks on say / think / convey / search / what; the + pole's logit effect suppresses 'interpret', 'information', 'facts', so the - pole promotes them. Probe: 'in search of the relevant' 0.68, 'convey' 0.34, 'or think' 0.32 vs 'or carry' 0.03.
